title: Browser hacking: Let's make "Cookie Clicker" playable in Ladybird!
summary: In a long live-coding session, Andreas Kling works on making the Cookie Clicker game playable in the Ladybird browser from SerenityOS. He tracks down bugs in the browser engine and fixes them.
why: HN loves the Browser hacking series for its clear debugging method of reducing bugs to minimal reproductions, which people say influenced their own testing.

quote.text: At one point, he deletes half the HTML file to isolate where in the site the problematic code is.
